Item.Hint: Enter Site ID or select from ListVal

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_lov boolean;
 v_name varchar2(50);
BEGIN
 IF :control_block.site_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT lc.location_id
 INTO v_name
 FROM locations lc, drives dr
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND dr.location_id = lc.location_id
 AND (lc.location_id = :control_block.site_id
 OR lc.location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM';
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('11103');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN others then
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_site');
 IF NOT v_lov THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_name varchar(100);
 v_lov boolean;
BEGIN
 IF :control_block.drive_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT c.name 
 INTO v_name
 FROM drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
 WHERE c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 AND a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 AND a.status = 'CNFRM' 
 AND (c.name like decode(:control_block.drive_id,null,'%','%'||:control_block.drive_id||'%')
 OR a.drive_id = nvl(:control_block.drive_id, a.drive_id))
 and a.drive_date = :control_block.s_start_date
 AND a.location_id = nvl(:control_block.site_id, a.location_id)
 AND a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('11109');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_drive_id');
 IF NOT v_lov THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_time number;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT to_char(a.drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),a.location_id, Initcap(b.location_name),nvl(a.sch_travel_time, 0)
 INTO :pickup_schedule.drive_date, :pickup_schedule.site_id,:pickup_schedule.site_name,
 :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time
 FROM drives a, locations b
 WHERE a.drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id
 AND a.location_id = b.location_id
 AND b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 AND rownum=1;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 Declare
 v_local_time date;--timestamp;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_time2 date;
Begin 
 /* Convert GMT hh:mi into local time hh:mi for pick_up_time*/
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time,v_local_time1); 
 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time :=to_date(to_char(v_local_time1,'HH24:MI'),'HH24:MI'); -- Commented by Kishore on 01/12/2012. IM 6148, IM 6271
 :pickup_schedule.pick_up_time := v_local_time1; -- Added by Kishore on 01/12/2012. IM 6148, IM 6271
 else
 :pickup_schedule.pick_up_time:=:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time;
 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time; 
 end if;
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:pickup_schedule.dispatch_time,v_local_time); 
 :pickup_schedule.dispatch_time := v_local_time;
 --message(':pick dis time'||' '||to_date(:pickup_schedule.dispatch_time_am,'HH24:MI'));pause; 
 else
 :pickup_schedule.dispatch_time:=:pickup_schedule.dispatch_time;
 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time; 
 end if;
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:pickup_schedule.return_time,v_local_time2); 
 :pickup_schedule.return_time_am := v_local_time2;
 --message(':pick dis time'||' '||to_date(:pickup_schedule.dispatch_time_am,'HH24:MI'));pause; 
 else
 :pickup_schedule.return_time_am:=:pickup_schedule.return_time;
 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time; 
 end if;
 
 
 --End If;
End;
 v_time := :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time;
 IF v_time = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(travel_time, 0)
 INTO v_time
 FROM locations
 WHERE location_id = :pickup_schedule.site_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 null;
 END;
 END IF;
 :pickup_schedule.travel_time := v_time||' '||'mins'; 
 -- :pickup_schedule.return_time_am := :pickup_schedule.return_time;
 /** select driver name from employees **/ 
 IF(:pickup_schedule.driver_code is not null) THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT InitCap(substr(first_name,1,1)||'. '||substr(last_name,1,15)) name 
 INTO :pickup_schedule.driver_name 
 FROM employees 
 WHERE staff_no = :pickup_schedule.driver_code 
 AND emp_class = 'DRVR' 
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 AND rownum=1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF :pickup_schedule.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT Initcap(vehicle_name)
 INTO :pickup_schedule.vehicle_name
 FROM valid_vehicles
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND rownum =1 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 END IF;
 do_retrieve_start_time;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_START_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_start_time IS
 v_travel_time number;
 h_arrival_time date;
 v_date date;
 v_pickuptime date;
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
IF :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time != 0 THEN
 SELECT (p.pick_up_time - (nvl(sch_travel_time,0)/(60*24))) pick
 INTO v_date
 FROM drives dr, pickup_schedule p
 WHERE dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND p.drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id
 AND p.pickup_id = :pickup_schedule.pickup_id
 -- AND drive_date = :pickup_schedule.drive_date
 AND status = 'CNFRM';
ELSIF :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time =0 THEN 
 SELECT (p.pick_up_time - (nvl(travel_time,60)/(60*24)))pick
 INTO v_date
 FROM locations l, drives dr, pickup_schedule p
 WHERE l.location_id = dr.location_id
 AND l.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND p.pickup_id = :pickup_schedule.pickup_id
 -- AND drive_date = :pickup_schedule.drive_date
 AND status = 'CNFRM'
 AND p.drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id;
END IF;

 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date,v_local_time);
 
 
 :pickup_schedule.start_time := to_char(v_local_time, 'HH24:MI');
 
 else
 :pickup_schedule.start_time := to_char(v_date, 'HH24:MI');
 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time;
 
 end if;
 --:pickup_schedule.start_time := to_char(v_date, 'HH24:MI');
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SITE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT lc.location_id, lc.location_name
 FROM locations lc, drives dr
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND dr.location_id = lc.location_id
 AND (lc.location_id =nvl( :control_block.site_id, lc.location_id)
 OR lc.location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 AND dr.drive_date = nvl(:control_block.s_start_date, dr.drive_date)
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM'
 AND dr.chapter_id = lc.chapter_id
 AND dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select a.drive_id, c.name from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c where c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and a.drive_id = b.drive_id and a.status = 'CNFRM' and (c.name like decode(:control_block.drive_id,null,'%','%'||:control_block.drive_id||'%') 
or a.drive_id = nvl(:control_block.drive_id, a.drive_id))
and a.drive_date = :control_block.s_start_date
and a.location_id = nvl(:control_block.site_id, a.location_id)
and a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id
and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
order by 2

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select staff_no,substr(first_name,1,1)||' '||substr(last_name,1,15) driver_name from employees where chapter_id =:global.chapter_id and emp_class='DRVR' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by last_name asc

RecordGroup.Name: RG_REASON
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select code, description
from valid_master_codes
where code_type = 'DEREA'
and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_VEHICLE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select vehicle_id, vehicle_name
from valid_vehicles
where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
